description: This file contains TypeScript code defining interfaces, utility functions, and a main function for caching and transforming OpenAI chat completion requests, specifically for use with the OpenRouter API. It handles content conversion, caching strategies, and modifies request bodies based on cache data.

classes.name: SystemMapping
classes.description: Represents the mapping of system messages within the content conversion process.

classes.name: MessageMapping
classes.description: Represents the mapping of user and assistant messages within the content conversion process.

classes.name: ConversionResult
classes.description: Holds the result of converting a chat completion request into an anthropic-compatible format, including mappings and the transformed body.

methods.name: convertContentToBlocks
methods.description: Converts message content into content blocks suitable for processing, handling strings, arrays, and different content types.

methods.name: convertToAnthropic
methods.description: Transforms OpenAI chat completion parameters into an anthropic-compatible message format, creating system and user message mappings.
